name: Should I choose LED or traditional bulbs for my exterior lighting?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose LED or traditional bulbs for my exterior lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing between LED and traditional bulbs for exterior lighting, consider energy efficiency, lifespan, and initial cost. LEDs offer superior energy efficiency and a much longer lifespan, significantly reducing energy bills and maintenance needs over time. Traditional bulbs have a lower upfront cost but consume more energy and require more frequent replacement. While the initial investment for LEDs is higher, their long-term savings often make them the more cost-effective and environmentally friendly choice, aligning with sustainability goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: LEDs are more energy-efficient and last longer, saving money long-term, despite a higher initial cost. Traditional bulbs are cheaper upfront but cost more to operate.
